user.title: Set up Ripple
user.description:
Ripple finds Zigbee devices with the Ripple sensing firmware and turns them into room presence sensors.
Choose the Zigbee system that runs your devices.

z2m.title: Zigbee2MQTT
z2m.description:
Ripple talks to Zigbee2MQTT through the MQTT integration of Home Assistant.
Use the base topic set in Zigbee2MQTT.

settings.title: Set up Ripple
settings.description: Start read-only to check what Ripple finds before it changes anything.

data_description.allow_writes:
Off keeps Ripple read-only: it reads the devices and keeps your changes without sending them.
On sends settings, links and calibration to the devices.
data_description.protected_devices: Ripple never reads or writes these devices, for example a relay that drives an alarm.

abort.no_zigbee:
Ripple needs Zigbee Home Automation (ZHA) or Zigbee2MQTT with the MQTT integration.
Set one of them up and pair your devices first.

data_description.allow_writes:
Off keeps Ripple read-only: it reads the devices and keeps your changes without sending them.
On sends settings, links and calibration to the devices.
data_description.protected_devices: Ripple never reads or writes these devices, for example a relay that drives an alarm.
data_description.poll_interval_s:
How often Ripple reads the calibration and link status of each device.
Motion arrives as events and does not wait for this.
data_description.resync_minutes:
How often Ripple checks that the devices still hold its settings.
Used only when writes are allowed.

links.title: Links of a device
links.description: Pick the device whose links you want to change.

links_edit.title: Links of {device}
links_edit.description:
{device} detects presence on the radio path to each device you pick here.
Pick devices whose path crosses the room.
At most {max}.
Calibrate the room afterwards.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description:
Each Home Assistant area with a Ripple device is a room automatically.
Add a room here for devices that work together across areas, or for a device that serves two rooms.

error.too_many: A device listens to at most 10 devices.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the room.

abort.no_switches: No Ripple device has been found yet.

read_only_pending.title: Ripple changes not sent
read_only_pending.description:
Ripple is read-only and {count} devices have changes that were saved but not sent.
To send them, open Ripple, Configure, Settings, and turn on "Allow writes to devices".

quirk_not_applied.title: Ripple devices loaded without the Ripple quirk
quirk_not_applied.description:
Ripple found {count} devices with Ripple firmware that ZHA loaded without the Ripple quirk, or with an older one: {names}.
ZHA loads the quirk file ripple_quirks.py from its custom_quirks_path when Home Assistant starts.
Restart Home Assistant to apply it.
Ripple does not reload ZHA.

quirk_broken.title: Ripple quirk file could not be written
quirk_broken.description:
Ripple found {count} devices with Ripple firmware that ZHA loaded without the Ripple quirk: {names}.
Ripple could not write ripple_quirks.py into the ZHA custom_quirks_path, see the Home Assistant log.

quirk_duplicate.title: Another quirk file for the Ripple devices
quirk_duplicate.description:
ZHA also loads a quirk for the same device models from: {files}.
Two quirks for one model make ZHA pick one of them.
Remove or rename that file, then restart Home Assistant.
Ripple does not delete it.

quirk_no_path.title: ZHA has no custom_quirks_path
quirk_no_path.description:
Ripple gives ZHA its quirk as a file, ripple_quirks.py, in the ZHA custom_quirks_path, and ZHA loads it when it starts.
Add to configuration.yaml:

zha:
  custom_quirks_path: /config/custom_zha_quirks/

then restart Home Assistant.
Ripple never changes ZHA itself.

quirk_restart.title: Restart Home Assistant to load the Ripple quirk
quirk_restart.description:
Ripple wrote a new version of its ZHA quirk to {file}.
ZHA loads it at the next Home Assistant start.

z2m_converter.title: Ripple converter not installed in Zigbee2MQTT
z2m_converter.description:
Zigbee2MQTT did not accept the Ripple external converter: {error}
Check that Zigbee2MQTT runs, that its base topic matches the Ripple setup, and look at the Zigbee2MQTT log.

writes_disabled.message:
Ripple is read-only.
Turn on "Allow writes to devices" in the Ripple settings to calibrate.
